Owned changes are limited to src/ptest/scheduler.py, tests/ng/test_scheduler.py, and this report. The per-node psutil.NoSuchProcess path now distinguishes the registered guard from descendant observation rows: a live guard identity is compared through the existing _same_identity(..., row, "guard") path, while descendant PID reuse continues to compare the persisted observation birth. The race therefore cannot index the guard row as though it contained an unprefixed birth field. A same-PID/new-birth guard is conservatively represented by the existing uncertainty sentinel, becomes typed unsupported-detached-descendant uncertainty, and retains its scheduler charge.

Secure-by-spec negative contract: when the guard raises NoSuchProcess during its children walk and immediately reappears under the same PID with a new birth identity, poll must not leak KeyError, release the lease, or grant waiting work. The deterministic fake kernel changes the identity at the exception boundary. The regression asserts LeaseState.UNCERTAIN, a typed unsupported-detached-descendant Problem, and a follower that remains QUEUED without a grant under a one-slot/one-job domain. The pre-existing listed-then-reaped descendant behavior, descendant PID-reuse cleanup, inaccessible-tree uncertainty, finalization, capacity, and process-lifecycle contracts remain covered by the complete owned module.
